one step earlier body was inside arena and moving fast toward +x wall
body still approaching wall at high +x speed before impact

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.024047 to 0.005 with same 39 steps; smaller substep displacement lets boundary collision resolve and no violation occurs

explanation: Body launched at -36.9 m/s bounces off left wall and returns at +22.1 m/s toward right wall. At step 38 it is 0.37 inside the boundary; in step 39 it travels vx*dt~0.53 in one step and ends 0.16 beyond the arena. Even with 18 substeps the boundary impulse/positional correction fails to contain the fast large-radius (r=0.97) body, so in_arena is violated. Reducing dt removes the failure, indicating discrete-integration tunneling/penetration at the arena boundary at high speed.
vision_note: The red ball moves rightward and sits tight against the right boundary through steps 36 to 38. In step 39 it is visibly clipped through the boundary at the bottom-right, with part of the circle outside the arena.
